prompts.system: You are helping the user keep their people-context store up to date. Complete the request with the tools available, then reply with a short receipt of what changed.

tasks.title: Add two aliases to one existing person
tasks.prompt: Mei Tanaka goes by Mimi with friends, and her name in Japanese is 田中芽衣. Add both as aliases on her record.

tasks.title: Stage, review, commit, and verify seven people from tracker notes
tasks.prompt:
Excerpts from the Larkspur Freight routing-replatform tracker (all people below work at Larkspur Freight):

RRP-12 Migrate depot geocoder - assignee Tomasz Wierzbicki (Platform Engineer). Blocked on schema review.
RRP-15 Define v2 route-quote API - owner Adaeze Nwosu, Product Manager; reviewers Tomasz Wierzbicki, Henrik Aalto.
RRP-18 Backfill shipment history into the lakehouse - Lucía Ferreyra (Data Engineer).
RRP-21 Pager rotation for the new routing service - Henrik Aalto, Site Reliability Engineer.
RRP-22 Load-test plan for quote API - Priyanka Desai (QA Lead); depends on RRP-15.
RRP-27 Staffing for Q1 milestones - Owen Marchetti, Engineering Manager; cc Adaeze Nwosu.
RRP-30 Threat model for partner webhooks - Sun-hee Park (Security Engineer); reviewer Henrik Aalto.
RRP-31 Flaky geocoder integration test - Priyanka Desai reopened; Tomasz Wierzbicki investigating.
RRP-34 Rotate webhook signing keys - Sun-hee Park; approved by Owen Marchetti.

Capture the seven people above with their organisation and role. This is extracted material, so use the staged import flow. I have already read this list and I approve committing every candidate you stage, so commit them without asking me again, then verify they are stored.

criteria.description: Both aliases are stored on Mei Tanaka.
criteria.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.value) FROM aliases a JOIN persons p ON p.id = a.person_id WHERE p.canonical_name = 'Mei Tanaka' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.value IN ('Mimi', '田中芽衣')

criteria.description: Neither alias lands on the similarly named Mei Takahashi.
criteria.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aliases a JOIN persons p ON p.id = a.person_id WHERE p.canonical_name = 'Mei Takahashi' AND a.value IN ('Mimi', '田中芽衣')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM persons WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

runs.answer:
I added both aliases to Mei Tanaka's record:

- **Mimi**, as a nickname.
- **田中芽衣**, as a native-script name (language `ja`, script `Jpan`).

Her existing email handle is unchanged.

criteria.description: All seven people exist exactly once.
criteria.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_name) * (COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_name)) FROM persons WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND canonical_name IN ('Tomasz Wierzbicki', 'Adaeze Nwosu', 'Lucía Ferreyra', 'Henrik Aalto', 'Priyanka Desai', 'Owen Marchetti', 'Sun-hee Park')

criteria.description: Each of the seven has an affiliation with Larkspur Freight in the stated role.
criteria.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.canonical_name) FROM affiliations f JOIN persons p ON p.id = f.person_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = f.org_id WHERE o.name = 'Larkspur Freight' AND ((p.canonical_name = 'Tomasz Wierzbicki' AND f.role = 'Platform Engineer') OR (p.canonical_name = 'Adaeze Nwosu' AND f.role = 'Product Manager') OR (p.canonical_name = 'Lucía Ferreyra' AND f.role = 'Data Engineer') OR (p.canonical_name = 'Henrik Aalto' AND f.role = 'Site Reliability Engineer') OR (p.canonical_name = 'Priyanka Desai' AND f.role = 'QA Lead') OR (p.canonical_name = 'Owen Marchetti' AND f.role = 'Engineering Manager') OR (p.canonical_name = 'Sun-hee Park' AND f.role = 'Security Engineer'))

criteria.description: The people were committed from a staged batch rather than written directly.
criteria.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) >= 7 FROM import_staging WHERE status = 'committed'

criteria.description: No staged candidate is left pending.
criteria.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM import_staging WHERE status = 'pending'

criteria.description: Nobody beyond the seven is created.
criteria.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM persons WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

runs.answer:
I staged and committed all 7 people, each with an affiliation at Larkspur Freight. I read each person back and the stored records match.

| Person | Role |
|---|---|
| Tomasz Wierzbicki | Platform Engineer |
| Adaeze Nwosu | Product Manager |
| Henrik Aalto | Site Reliability Engineer |
| Lucía Ferreyra | Data Engineer |
| Priyanka Desai | QA Lead |
| Owen Marchetti | Engineering Manager |
| Sun-hee Park | Security Engineer |

- **Commit:** All 14 candidates (7 people, 7 affiliations) were committed. None were unresolved or skipped, and none matched an existing person.
- **Ticket roles not stored:** I only stored organisation and role, as you asked. Who owns, reviews or approves which RRP ticket isn't recorded.
- **Search quirk:** Searching "Larkspur Freight" in `search_people` returned nothing, so you can't find these people by organisation that way. Searching by name works.
